label: Everything other than the primary is a creature, from participation
description: Derives that everything other than the primary is a creature: each other thing has participated being (OPEN reading of q.44 a.1 co.), what has participated being has a distinct cause of its being (q.44 a.1 ad 1, STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE), and what has its being caused by another is a creature (OPEN reading of DEF-CREATURE).
